Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the impermissible motive element of a claim under chapter 49.60 RCW.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to violations of Washington's law againstdiscrimination; and adding a new section to chapter 49.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Where an impermissible motive is an element of a claim under thischapter, a violation is established where the complaining partydemonstrates that the impermissible motive was a substantial factor,not that it was the only factor or the main factor, or that thecomplaining party would not have been subject to the treatment absentthe impermissible motive. It is not a defense to liability or reliefthat the complaining party would have been subject to the sametreatment absent the impermissible motive.
